title: A person in MallWorld explained why we cant contact each other. Is there a way around it?
content: First-> Not every dream is in MallWorld, even mall dreams don't mean you are in MallWorld. I'm semi-lucid in Mall-world. I know its a dream but I cant change stuff and I still have fear there. I was in the wooded area of MallWorld, with a group of people taking the fight to the aliens. It was rainy, muddy, low visibility. We all had military gear and tents. I was with a group of around 5-7 people but there were other groups scattered about. While we were in a tent, one person said: Guy: "Wow, these battles are getting bigger and bigger everytime" me: "How do you know about these battles" (i was surprised that a dream character knew about it) Guy: "I get called up here all the time, the aliens are gaining a lot of ground" Me: "wait, so you know you are also dreaming?" Guy: "yes" Me: "howcome if everyone here is dreaming, we cant see each other in waking life?" Guy: \*points at someone "that is an old woman from China, this guy over here is a recent born baby from Slovakia, I'm from somewhere else and so on. Even if you recall this dream, the others might not, and how would you contact an old lady that does not speak your language?" Me: "so what should we do?" Guy: "fight with everything you have when you see the aliens" Could there be a way to contact each other, or to do something bizzare in mallworld so we know we are in the same "server".
